name: shots
description: Upload host for Loren: a Cloudflare Worker that stores files in R2

UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: A long random string. Whoever has it can upload; anyone with a link can view. Paste the same value into the Loren upload settings as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

FILES.description: R2 bucket that stores the uploaded files.

MAX_MB.description: Largest upload accepted, in MB (the Workers request body limit applies).
